behavior.config: children map with required recursive childPolicy; sorted child names and empty maps retain arena ownership and depth limits
behavior.selector: unary and streaming RequestOptions.xds_cluster are RPC-local attributes; shared inputs copy the selector and wire headers do not contain it
behavior.routing: cluster manager selects a child directly using the RPC attribute; missing/unknown cluster names fail with local UnknownCluster before HEADERS
behavior.resolver: this adapter uses the next hierarchical_path component as the cluster name, then delegates remaining path and complete policy behavior to the selected child, including nested locality
behavior.ordinary_isolation: ordinary RPC connection warm-up is scoped to the chosen cluster; an unrelated refused custom connector records zero calls
behavior.shared_queue: per-job selected worker belongs to its selected cluster; one failed-child wait-for-ready call cannot block healthy child claims; fail-fast uses selected-child connectivity even while an unrelated sibling is READY
behavior.lifecycle: deadline/cancellation/worker destruction clear queued provisional picks; config publication resets them, removes new admission for deleted clusters, preserves active RPC completion and can reuse retained transports on restoration
behavior.policy_transition: cluster-manager markers distinguish direct-selection nodes from weighted nodes during runtime equality, state transfer and removed-child retention
behavior.structure: cohesive config validation, route selection and shared queue-dispatch modules with owning-module unit and socket lifecycle tests

targeted_debug.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC cluster manager' -Dtest-filter='gRPC xDS locality' --summary all

regressions: required/supported childPolicy, malformed map/child policies and bounded recursive config
unknown/missing cluster fails before request submission
owned selector copies for unary and streaming survive caller memory changes
ordinary and shared per-RPC a/b child routing with exact round-robin inside a
both transports route duplex using the same local selector
failed-cluster queued wait-for-ready expires while a later healthy b call completes
fail-fast failed cluster returns ConnectionUnavailable despite a ready sibling
removed child rejects new RPCs and restored child resumes through retained connections
admitted RPC on removed a finishes after b serves a later request
nested locality policy constructor and full allocation rollback
ordinary RPC never calls an unrelated refused custom connector

references.roles: grpc-core source defines children/childPolicy and RPC cluster attribute semantics; actual official grpc-js-xds manager picker executes deterministic child and unknown/removed tests; official grpc-js servers independently count native unary/duplex and transport sessions

remaining_scope: ADS discovery, route-config selector integration, xDS cluster implementation/load reporting and remaining protocol completeness/performance evidence remain open.
